setup: You are given [[name]] = [[num]]/[[den]] and asked for its reciprocal [[recip]].

steps.say: The reciprocal of a value is one divided by it, which flips the fraction: [[num]]/[[den]] becomes [[den]]/[[num]].
Written as one fraction, that is 1 divided by ([[num]]/[[den]]) = [[recip_num]]/[[recip_den]].
